questions.question: Write the method of checking coliform bacteria in drinking water.
questions.solution_html:
• The Most Probable Number (MPN) test for coliforms involves serial
  • dilution of a water sample and inoculating multiple tubes of a
  • selective medium like lactose broth with measured volumes of each
  • dilution. After incubation, a positive result is indicated by gas
  • bubbles and acid production in the tubes, which is often detected by
  • bubble in an inverted Durham tube and a color change from red to
  • yellow in the medium. The number of positive tubes at each dilution
  • is then used in conjunction with a standard statistical table to
  • estimate the coliform count per 100 mL of the original sample.
